title: Dusty Felt Heartbeat
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A warm, slightly gritty bass synth locks in with a TR-606 drum machine over lightly bit-crushed piano chords, giving the track an intimate lo-fi warmth. The arrangement expands from a sparse bass-and-hats intro through a full groove with snare and piano melody, then gradually winds down to a quiet, hazy close.
code:
setcpm(110/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>*8").s("jvbass").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(300, 900)).gain(0.85).coarse(2),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.4).pan(sine.range(0.4, 0.6)).degradeBy(0.3)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>*8").s("jvbass").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(400, 1100)).gain(0.9).coarse(2),
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.85),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.45).pan(sine.range(0.4, 0.6)).degradeBy(0.2),
    note("<[c4,eb4,g4] [c4,eb4,g4] [ab3,c4,eb4] [g3,bb3,d4]>").s("piano").gain(0.6).room(0.4).lpf(1800).crush(7).attack(0.02).release(0.4)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>*8").s("jvbass").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(500, 1400)).gain(0.95).coarse(2).off(0.125, x => x.gain(0.4).add(note(12))),
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.9),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).room(0.25),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).degradeBy(0.15).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<[c4,eb4,g4] [c4,eb4,g4] [ab3,c4,eb4] [g3,bb3,d4]>").s("piano").gain(0.65).room(0.4).lpf(2200).crush(8).attack(0.02).release(0.5),
    n("0 ~ 2 ~ 4 ~ <5 7> ~").scale("C4:minor").s("piano").gain(0.45).room(0.5).crush(7).delay(0.3).lpf(2400)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1>*4").s("jvbass").lpf(700).gain(0.85).coarse(2).room(0.3),
    note("<[c4,eb4,g4] [ab3,c4,eb4]>").s("piano").gain(0.6).room(0.6).lpf(1600).crush(6).attack(0.05).release(0.8),
    s("hh*2").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.35).degradeBy(0.4)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>*8").s("jvbass").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(600, 1600)).gain(0.95).coarse(2).off(0.125, x => x.gain(0.4).add(note(12))),
    s("bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.9),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).room(0.25),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).degradeBy(0.15).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<[c4,eb4,g4] [c4,eb4,g4] [ab3,c4,eb4] [g3,bb3,d4]>").s("piano").gain(0.65).room(0.4).lpf(2400).crush(8).attack(0.02).release(0.5),
    n("0 ~ 2 ~ 4 ~ <5 7> ~").scale("C4:minor").s("piano").gain(0.5).room(0.5).crush(7).delay(0.3).lpf(2600).every(8, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>*8").s("jvbass").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(800, 300)).gain(0.8).coarse(2),
    note("<[c4,eb4,g4] [ab3,c4,eb4]>").s("piano").gain(0.55).room(0.6).lpf(1400).crush(6).attack(0.05).release(0.9),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.35).degradeBy(0.5)
  )]
)
